ALLIENT INC is a for-profit public company headquartered in Williamsville, New York, with ticker ALNT and CIK 0000046129. Its website, alantra.com, presents Alantra, which the site describes as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. The site says Alantra provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors.

The website states that Alantra operates a listed partnership model, with teams working within corporate governance structures while having autonomy and being personally invested in the firm. It also describes an ambition to support clients through an accountable and ethical approach. The available material does not identify any AI products.

New York legal exposure data lists 448 matters involving the company. No litigation cases, MCP servers, or tracked products are identified in the material.
